sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content: Welcome to Money Buddy! This guide will help you navigate the chatbot and learn about financial concepts.

sections.title: Learning Concepts
sections.content: Choose 'Learn a concept' to understand financial terms. Money Buddy will explain in simple language with real-world examples.

sections.title: Taking Quizzes
sections.content: Test your knowledge with our 5 financial quizzes. Each quiz has 4 options. Pick the correct answer!

sections.title: Myth vs Fact
sections.content: Learn what's true and what's false about finance. We debunk 5 common misconceptions.

sections.title: Story Mode
sections.content: Understand through real-life stories. See how money grows over time with smart investing.

tips: Start with basic concepts before taking quizzes
Read the explanations carefully - they help you understand why answers are correct
Use the myth vs fact section to clear up misconceptions
Stories show real examples of how money grows
Remember: this is educational content, not financial advice
